purpose: Teach: こむ/採っ/ひざ/向く/在る/挙句/物語っ/できあがっ

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お家に駆けこむお父さんを見て嬉しかったわ
lines.en: You know, Sho, it made me so happy to see your dad rushing in like that.
lines.style: Warm observation, a gentle smile in her voice. Soft opening. Speaking to Sho but also partly to herself, remembering the moment. Tender, unhurried.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと一緒に貝殻を採ったよ
lines.en: Mom, I collected shells with Dad today.
lines.style: Bright, immediate excitement. Quick onset. Words tumbling a little — eager to share. Voice lifts on the memory. Genuine, unguarded child energy.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがひざに乗せて絵本読んで下さるわ
lines.en: And your dad had you on his lap reading picture books together.
lines.style: Quiet wonder. Speaking almost to herself now, seeing the scene. Soft, wondering tone. Slight pause as she takes in the image. Voice trails with affection.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんの方を向くと安心するよ
lines.en: Mom, when I look at Dad's face, I feel safe.
lines.style: Small, serious voice. Vulnerable admission. Slow pace. No rush — he's stating something true that matters. Quiet conviction underneath.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが今お家に在るから一緒にお話ししようね
lines.en: Your dad's home right now, Sho. Why don't you two talk together?
lines.style: Practical, warm. Light encouragement without pushing. Even pacing. Slight lift at the suggestion, inviting. The voice of someone creating space for something good.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、宿題の挙句にぼくは眠くなったよ
lines.en: Mom, I got sleepy after I finished my homework.
lines.style: Small, half-tired laugh almost in there. Matter-of-fact but with a thread of weariness. Slight drag on the pace. The drowsy honesty of a child past his bedtime.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが昔の冒険を物語って下さったわ
lines.en: Your dad told you stories of his adventures from long ago.
lines.style: Nostalgic, almost dreaming. Slower pace. Warm wonder at the moment just past. Voice softens on 'long ago' — she's transported to watching them together. Breath easy, unhurried.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと工作ができあがって嬉しいよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I finished making something together, and I'm so happy.
lines.style: Glowing pride. Warm, clear voice. The joy of completion and shared making. Bounces slightly upward on 'finished.' Small but genuine — the happiness of having made something with Dad.
